Alyssa / Grace — technical details on retention and audit logs below. Sharing matrix (attachment: log-retention-matrix.xlsx).

1) Audit log types we can provide:
   - Control plane audit logs (who changed config, API keys): retained 365 days by default; exportable as newline-delimited JSON with SHA256 checksums.
   - Request/trace logs (per-request metadata, latencies): retained 90 days; can be exported to your S3 (encrypted) for longer retention.
   - KV cache change events (for debugging causal flows): retained 30 days; can be pushed to bucket on request.

2) Integrity & attestation:
   - We sign exported artifacts with our KMS key; we can supply key IDs and a signature manifest for KPMG.
   - WORM staging area available for auditor downloads for a 14-day window; we can extend on request.

3) Throughput notes:
   - The serving runtime supports progressive kernel selection and autoscaling. For 2x steady-state we recommend a 4-week prod ramp and an initial reserved pool to absorb peak warmup.
   - Engineering will coordinate a smoke test week with your SREs; please propose dates in Aug.
